# Frozen to the validated WakeSurrogate runtime. The .eqx weights are
# deserialised against these versions, so an unpinned resolve would silently
# shift every prediction. Note this is the container runtime (Python 3.11) and
# is deliberately distinct from scripts/wake_surrogate/requirements.txt, which
# records the Python 3.10 training host where jax 0.6.2 is the newest wheel.

equinox==0.13.8
